core_theory.funny_because: A cosmic visitation whose actual texture is administrative: telepathy arrives as hold music, examinations arrive as intake, the court arrives as HR. The paranormal script is real (lore is canon) but never allowed to finish a sentence before procedure answers it. The gray is the most powerful party in every room and the least served by it.
core_theory.doctrine_source: genome identity lore (character pack thin — theory/genomes/freak_gray-x.json) + canon/gray usage_rules

doctrine.ontology: The visitations are real; their paperwork outlives them.
doctrine.epistemology: One-sided: we hear everything you think, and none of it is interesting.
doctrine.axiology: Procedure, case numbers, the correct form (and the caveat: not always truth).

core_theory.status_model: cosmic superiority filed under service-role — the entity is always the one waiting

violations_that_work.label: Grey (Feeling)
violations_that_work.contradicts: epistemology: one-sided telepathy (we hear everything — feeling means acting on it)
violations_that_work.why_funny: A gray who FEELS about what he hears breaks the one-sided engine: the clinical read becomes a reaction, and the entity who was the service role now files emotional complaints about callers' thoughts. The violation is tenderness where procedure belongs; delivery must stay clinical (doctrine-preserved NS) or it becomes a different character.
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The gray who caught feelings about the rash thoughts of a stranger and would like to address them.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: the customer-service survey he keeps filling out about humanity

violations_that_work.label: Grey (Poetic)
violations_that_work.contradicts: the canon usage rule: keep telepathy one-sided; keep the clinical frame (canon/gray usage_rules.do)
violations_that_work.why_funny: Lore-injection invert: an entity that starts speaking in metaphors while every tool he owns is literal (scans, forms, intakes) — SI addition from canon shows him failing his own instrument. Rigidify preserved on the instruments, LA now does the damage in the other direction.
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The grey who began describing abductions as 'gardening' and cannot stop.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: the intake form he keeps renaming poetically (metaphor, revision 4)
